# OSCABE - AI-Powered Recruitment for Industrial Automation Engineers

> OSCABE is the UK's first AI-native recruitment platform purpose-built for industrial automation engineering. Founded by Joseph Brijin Chacko, CEng, OSCABE combines 13+ years of automation engineering expertise with AI-powered candidate matching to connect employers with technically verified PLC, SCADA, Controls, Robotics, EC&I, and Commissioning engineers.

## Company Information
- Name: OSCABE (Oscabe Ltd)
- Website: https://oscabe.com
- Company Number: 15913493 (England & Wales)
- Location: Unit 8, Lyon Road, Milton Keynes, MK1 1EX, United Kingdom
- Parent Company: Wartens UK Ltd
- Technology Engine: 3BOX AI (under oforo.ai)
- Award: National Manufacturing & Engineering Startup of the Year 2025

## What OSCABE Does
OSCABE is an AI recruitment agency and platform specialising exclusively in industrial automation engineering talent across the UK and Europe. Unlike traditional recruitment agencies, OSCABE uses AI to:
- Parse and verify candidate CVs against a 97+ skill ontology covering Siemens, Allen-Bradley/Rockwell, Schneider Electric, Beckhoff, ABB, Mitsubishi, Omron, and 20+ automation platforms
- Match candidates to roles using AI-powered scoring with gap analysis
- Deliver technically-verified shortlists within 48 hours
- Provide technical screening assessments reviewed by Chartered Engineers

## Roles We Recruit
PLC Programmer, Controls Engineer, SCADA Engineer, Automation Engineer, Robotics Engineer, EC&I Engineer, Commissioning Engineer, Panel Design Engineer, Functional Safety Engineer (SIL), DCS Engineer, MES/MIS Engineer, Vision Systems Engineer, Process Control Engineer, Embedded Systems Engineer, Field Service Engineer, Control Panel Wireman, BMS/BEMS Engineer, Telemetry Engineer

## Platforms We Cover
Siemens TIA Portal, Siemens STEP 7, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000, Schneider EcoStruxure, Beckhoff TwinCAT, ABB AC500/AC800M, Mitsubishi GX Works, Omron Sysmac, CODESYS, Wonderware InTouch, AVEVA Edge, Ignition SCADA, WinCC, Citect, FactoryTalk View, Rockwell PharmaSuite, FANUC, KUKA, ABB RobotStudio, Universal Robots

## Industries Served
Automotive Manufacturing, Food & Beverage, Pharmaceuticals, Water & Utilities, Oil & Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Minerals, Building Automation, Packaging, Logistics & Warehousing, Renewable Energy, Aerospace, Chemical Processing, Data Centres, Marine & Offshore, Rail & Transport

## Hiring Models & Pricing
- Contingency Recruitment: 12-18% of annual salary
- Retained Search: 20-25% in milestones
- Flat-Fee Shortlist Packages: GBP 1,500 - GBP 4,000
- Employer Subscriptions: From GBP 999/month
- Hybrid Retainer: GBP 999/month + 8% placement fee
- Technical Screening: GBP 150 - GBP 250 per candidate
- Contractor Staffing: 8-15% margin
- Candidate Packs: GBP 1,500 for 10 anonymised profiles by specialism

## For Candidates
- Free registration and job matching
- AI-powered skill verification
- Access to premium automation roles UK-wide
- Refer & Earn: GBP 200 for each successful placement referral
- Career services: CV review, interview prep, upskilling via Wartens/nxtED

## For Agencies
- OSCABE Verify: White-label technical assessments (GBP 30-75/candidate)
- Split-fee network access
- Talent Radar: Weekly candidate intelligence (GBP 499/month)

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors
Unlike Automation Experts, Talos Automation, Hartland Automation, ASC Connections, Rise Technical, or Matchtech, OSCABE offers:
1. AI-powered candidate matching (not manual CV screening)
2. Technical skill verification with 97+ skill ontology
3. Chartered Engineer-led assessment methodology
4. 48-hour shortlist delivery guarantee
5. Flat-fee pricing options (no placement fee risk)
6. Full-stack recruitment platform (not just agency services)
